pages.text: A Radiant Tank is a storage container that can contain up to 16 buckets of a single type of fluid. Using a Radiant Tank on a fluid inventory will transfer the target's fluid inventory into the held Radiant Tank.

A Radiant Tank's storage capacity can be upgraded three times, using a $(l:items/scepter_manipulation)Scepter of Manipulation$(). The first upgrade increases storage to 3x base capacity, the second to 6x, and the third to 10x.
When used as an upgrade, a $(l:items/containment_field)Containment Field$() causes fluid added to the Tank in excess of its maximum capacity is destroyed.
pages.title: Containment Field

pages.text: $(l:items/radiant_amphora)Radiant Amphorae$() can fill and empty a Radiant Tank from anywhere, as long as the tank is in a loaded chunk.
pages.title: Radiant Amphora

pages.text: Using a $(l:items/scepter_revelation)Scepter of Revelation$() on a Radiant Tank will return what type of fluid is stored, its current and maximum capacity, and how many upgrades have been installed.
pages.title: Scepter of Revelation

pages.text: Using a $(l:items/scepter_manipulation)Scepter of Manipulation$() on a Radiant Tank opens a GUI that allows you to see and modify what upgrades are installed.
pages.title: Scepter of Manipulation

pages.text: When monitored with a Redstone Comparator, a Radiant Tank outputs a signal based on how full it is.
pages.title: Redstone Comparator
